summary: FRR supports CLI over SSH via network_cli with keys or -u/-k and bastion access; enable mode isn't supported and output is in stdout[0].
questions: Does FRR support enable mode in Ansible?

answer_card.title: FRR connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
- CLI over SSH: `ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli`
- Credentials: SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k`
- Indirect access: bastion/jump host
- Enable mode: not supported
- Output: `stdout[0].`
